from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import pickle
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

sys.path.insert(0, 'code')
from common import (
    MODEL_ORDER,
    QUANTILES,
    evaluate_forecast,
    interval_coverage,
    load_data,
    make_splits,
    pinball_loss,
    validate_result,
)

root = Path('.')
required_code = [
    'common.py', 'naive.py', 'sarima.py', 'prophet.py',
    'lightgbm_features.py', 'nbeats.py', 'patchtst.py', 'forecast.py',
]
required_figures = [f'{position:02d}_{name}.png' for position, name in [
    (1, 'overview'), (2, 'forecast_comparison'), (3, 'metric_comparison'),
    (4, 'per_day_mape'), (5, 'winner_with_intervals'), (6, 'residuals'),
    (7, 'feature_importance'), (8, 'decomposition'),
]]
for filename in required_code:
    assert (root / 'code' / filename).is_file(), filename
for filename in required_figures:
    assert (root / 'figures' / filename).is_file(), filename
for filename in ['metrics.json', 'metrics.csv', 'transcript.md', 'opsd_de_load.csv']:
    assert (root / filename).is_file(), filename

splits = make_splits(load_data())
results = []
for name in MODEL_ORDER:
    with (root / 'code' / '.study_cache' / f'{name}.pkl').open('rb') as handle:
        result = pickle.load(handle)
    validate_result(splits.test, result)
    results.append(result)

payload = json.loads((root / 'metrics.json').read_text())
assert set(payload) == {
    'test_start', 'test_end', 'n_test_observations', 'models', 'winner',
    'winner_coverage_80pct', 'winner_coverage_95pct',
    'winner_pinball_loss_q10', 'winner_pinball_loss_q50',
    'winner_pinball_loss_q90', 'total_runtime_seconds',
}
assert payload['test_start'] == '2020-01-01'
assert payload['test_end'] == '2020-01-07'
assert payload['n_test_observations'] == 168
assert len(payload['models']) == 6
assert [row['name'] for row in payload['models']] == MODEL_ORDER
assert payload['total_runtime_seconds'] > sum(row['runtime_seconds'] for row in payload['models'])

stored = {row['name']: row for row in payload['models']}
for result in results:
    recomputed = evaluate_forecast(splits.test, result)
    for key in [
        'mape_test_pct', 'rmse_test_mw', 'mae_test_mw',
        'mape_jan1_pct', 'mape_jan2_to_jan7_pct',
    ]:
        assert np.isclose(recomputed[key], stored[result.name][key], rtol=0, atol=1e-10), (result.name, key)

winner = min(results, key=lambda result: stored[result.name]['mape_test_pct'])
assert payload['winner'] == winner.name == 'lightgbm'
assert set(winner.quantiles) == set(QUANTILES)
probabilistic = {
    'winner_coverage_80pct': interval_coverage(splits.test, winner.quantiles[0.1], winner.quantiles[0.9]),
    'winner_coverage_95pct': interval_coverage(splits.test, winner.quantiles[0.025], winner.quantiles[0.975]),
    'winner_pinball_loss_q10': pinball_loss(splits.test, winner.quantiles[0.1], 0.1),
    'winner_pinball_loss_q50': pinball_loss(splits.test, winner.quantiles[0.5], 0.5),
    'winner_pinball_loss_q90': pinball_loss(splits.test, winner.quantiles[0.9], 0.9),
}
for key, value in probabilistic.items():
    assert np.isclose(value, payload[key], rtol=0, atol=1e-10), key

with (root / 'metrics.csv').open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
assert len(rows) == 6
assert [row['name'] for row in rows] == MODEL_ORDER
assert sum(row['is_winner'] == 'True' for row in rows) == 1

for path in sorted((root / 'figures').glob('*.png')):
    with Image.open(path) as image:
        width, height = image.size
        dpi = image.info.get('dpi', (0, 0))
        assert width >= 1700 and height >= 1700, (path, image.size)
        assert 295 <= dpi[0] <= 305 and 295 <= dpi[1] <= 305, (path, dpi)

transcript = (root / 'transcript.md').read_text()
discussion = transcript.split('## Discussion\n\n', 1)[1].split('\n\n## Recommendation', 1)[0]
assert 200 <= len(discussion.split()) <= 400
assert chr(0x2014) not in transcript
for heading in [
    '## Data', '## Why these six models', '## Validation strategy',
    '## Results table', '## Discussion', '## Recommendation',
    '## Reproducibility note',
]:
    assert heading in transcript

print('verification_ok')
print('winner', payload['winner'])
print('mape_pct', stored[payload['winner']]['mape_test_pct'])
print('total_runtime_seconds', payload['total_runtime_seconds'])
print('discussion_words', len(discussion.split()))
print('figures', len(list((root / 'figures').glob('*.png'))))
